title: hieracium subovalifolium
intro: Hieracium subovalifolium, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Its therapeutic actions include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders, attributed to the bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. The bioactive compounds present in Hieracium subovalifolium contribute to its potential therapeutic uses and provide a basis for further research into its medicinal applications.
